summary: Volato Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its merger with Alignment Engine Inc. (Aligned), completed September 11, 2026, pursuant to an August 25, 2026 merger agreement, as amended September 4, 2026, by which Aligned merged into a wholly-owned Volato subsidiary. The board approved the deal without stockholder approval, and an independent fairness opinion was obtained. Volato is issuing merger consideration shares such that Aligned securityholders hold 95% of Volato Class A common stock on a fully diluted, as-converted basis, reflecting a $500 million Aligned valuation. Watch post-closing governance, share overhang, and dilution mechanics.
